elements.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
elements.evidence: The Company may assign without consent to an affiliate.

elements.element: Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
elements.evidence: The Company may assign without consent to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets.

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
elements.evidence: HDI may not assign without the Company's prior written consent.

elements.element: Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
elements.evidence: The Company's consent to HDI's assignment shall not be unreasonably withheld.

elements.element: Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
elements.evidence: HDI may in no event assign the Agreement to a competitor of the Company.

elements.element: Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.
elements.evidence: A change of control of the Company gives HDI no right to terminate the Agreement.

elements.element: Both parties may assign to a successor.
elements.evidence: The Company may assign to a transaction successor, but HDI has no equivalent consent-free successor-assignment right.

elements.element: A successor assignment requires written notice.
elements.evidence: The clause imposes no written-notice requirement for the Company's assignment to a successor.
HDI's assignments require consent, but the clause does not comprehensively state that the Company's assignments outside the specified categories require consent.

elements.element: Consent to other assignments is not to be unreasonably withheld.
elements.evidence: The reasonableness restriction applies to the Company's consent to HDI assignments, but no reciprocal consent framework governs other Company assignments.
